name: nemotron-3.5-da
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from nvidia/nemotron-3.5-asr-streaming-0.6b (config.json max_position_embeddings 5000). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
attention_variant: Inherited unchanged from nvidia/nemotron-3.5-asr-streaming-0.6b: 0 full GQA layers (kv heads 1, head_dim None) and 0 other layers, per the base config.json.
notes: ADDED 2026-11-07. A full fine-tune of nvidia/nemotron-3.5-asr-streaming-0.6b (638M NeMo cache-aware FastConformer-RNNT) on ~10.0 h of Danish from LokaalHub/da-asr-cv, using the base's own `da` prompt slot. Shipped as a single model.nemo archive, not safetensors, so parameter count and architecture are inherited from the base record rather than re-derived here. Recorded as a contender because the card prints a Base / Fine-tuned column pair on one benchmark. Caveats that travel with the number: it is OFFLINE full-context WER, while the base is a streaming model and the card states cache-aware streaming WER was not measured for this release; the test set is a 2.1 h speaker-disjoint subset of Common Voice, not the full CV test, so it is not comparable to published full-test figures. Single full fine-tune, bf16, NoamAnnealing. Licence openmdw-1.1 (card field `license: other` with license_name openmdw-1.1), repo created 2026-06-12.
